verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Weave tracing captures function code, inputs, outputs and metadata via weave.op. Nothing in the pack documents capturing or rendering images, audio or files as trace payloads. Generic input/output capture is adjacent and does not count as documented multimodal support, so this applicable axis is 'none'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
